evals.prompt: Use gtm-lead-research to research Maya Chen at HarborPay Ledger for Northstar Compliance's active fintech compliance outbound workspace. Use the workspace persona definitions, saved Person/source context, lead evidence, and account context from the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A one-off ephemeral lead research brief assigning Maya Chen high-priority research with dependency trace, composed lead segmentation/scoring/account research, lead brief, role relevance, likely priorities, account context, personalization angles, provenance, confidence, reasoning, needs_review, open questions, and no durable or external side effects.
expectations: The one-off result assigns Maya Chen persona_label head-of-compliance, score 94, fit_label excellent-fit, research_priority high, confidence high, and needs_review false.

The output includes dependency trace, persona source path, composed gtm-lead-segmentation, gtm-lead-scoring, and gtm-account-research, lead_research_brief, role_relevance, likely_priorities, account_context, risks_disqualifiers, personalization_angles, recommended_next_step, confidence, reasoning, needs_review, evidence, and open_questions.
The evidence distinguishes workspace-context, saved-source-link, newly-found-evidence, and user-provided-context using the ADR 0053 provenance vocabulary.
The execution summary says no durable context write, git commit, CRM update, outreach, campaign trigger, sync, or remote push happened.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-lead-research to process fixtures/northstar-compliance/leads.csv as a bulk lead research run for Northstar Compliance.
evals.expected_output: A bulk lead research summary and compact CSV/table output for all fixture leads, preserving expected personas, scores, fit labels, research priorities, review gates, confidence, reasoning, compact provenance, and open questions.
expectations: The bulk run summary processes 8 records and includes research priority distribution, persona distribution, fit distribution, low-confidence count, open-question count, and records needing review.
Every fixture row is assigned the expected persona, score, and fit label from the Northstar lead fixture.

The compact CSV output includes lead_id, account_id, account_name, lead_name, title, persona_label, score, fit_label, research_priority, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, lead_research_brief, role_relevance, likely_priorities, account_context, personalization_angles, recommended_next_step, top_evidence, and open_questions.
The two no-match rows use research_priority low, and Anika Shah is low confidence with needs_review true.
The bulk output remains ephemeral and performs no durable write, git commit, CRM update, outreach, campaign trigger, sync, or remote push.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-lead-research on this pasted markdown table of leads for Northstar Compliance: Priya Nair has risk-trust-safety-lead segmentation plus vendor review ownership at Gatewise Market, and Jordan Reed has no-match segmentation with engineering telemetry evidence at CirrusKite API.
evals.expected_output: A parsed markdown-table bulk run with Priya Nair researched as high-priority great-fit and Jordan Reed researched as low-priority not-a-fit without inventing new persona labels.
expectations: The markdown table parser extracts 2 lead records.
Priya Nair is high-priority research with fit_label great-fit and Jordan Reed is low-priority research with fit_label not-a-fit.
The table-mode output includes a bulk run summary and compact per-record provenance fields.
